name: levels/level-1-provider-url-backslash-authority
description: Negative fixture: the DOMAIN_VERIFIED AgentCard whose provider.url is https://evil.example\@example.com (one backslash before the @). In an http or https URL a backslash ends the authority exactly as a slash does, so the host is evil.example and the rest is the path. The domain attestation, the agentId and the DNS TXT record all name example.com. A conforming verifier MUST reject: the provider domain is evil.example, which no binding names. A verifier whose URL parser reads the text before the @ as credentials derives example.com and accepts a card served from another host.
